thread.title: Three Decades of Hearing Care Right in Your Neighborhood
thread.title_full: Three Decades of Hearing Care Right in Your Neighborhood

author: Advertiser Content from CLEAR EAR
title: Three Decades of Hearing Care Right in Your Neighborhood
text:
When someone struggles to hear conversations at family gatherings or misses the doorbell, the solution shouldn't require driving across town or waiting weeks for an appointment. For more than 30 years, Clear Ear Hearing Aid has served Griffith and Lake County residents with a straightforward approach: bring expert hearing care directly to the community.
Since 1994, this local practice has built its reputation on accessibility. While many hearing care providers operate on rigid schedules, Clear Ear offers something different—regular check-ups every 60 to 90 days by appointment, and for those who can't make it to the office, house calls.
Professional Care Without the Corporate Feel
The team at Clear Ear Hearing Aid specializes in hearing aid services, from initial evaluations through ongoing maintenance. Every patient receives a complimentary hearing aid evaluation, visual ear exam, and regular cleanings. This isn't a one-time transaction model. The practice schedules consistent follow-ups to ensure devices continue working properly.
Located at 827 W. 45th Ave. in Griffith, the office handles hearing aid repairs and works with multiple brands, including Oticon. For residents dealing with hearing loss, having a local provider who knows their equipment and history makes troubleshooting faster and less stressful.
Why Regular Maintenance Matters
Hearing aids are sophisticated devices exposed to moisture, earwax and daily wear. Without routine cleanings, performance degrades. Many users don't realize their hearing aids need professional attention until they stop working entirely.
Clear Ear's model addresses this problem. By offering free cleanings and check-ups every few months, the practice helps patients maintain optimal hearing aid function. These appointments catch small issues before they become expensive repairs.
The visual ear exams also serve an important purpose. Earwax buildup can interfere with hearing aid performance and contribute to hearing difficulties. Regular exams help identify these issues early.
Solutions for Every Budget and Lifestyle
Not everyone needs the same hearing solution. Someone who spends time in noisy restaurants has different requirements than someone who primarily watches television at home. Clear Ear works with patients to find hearing aids that match their daily activities and financial situation.
The practice accepts various insurance plans and focuses on providing options across price points. This approach recognizes that hearing loss affects people from all economic backgrounds, and quality care shouldn't be reserved for those who can afford premium devices.
When Leaving Home Isn't Easy
For seniors with mobility challenges or individuals managing health conditions, traveling to appointments adds stress. Clear Ear's house call service removes this barrier. The same professional care available in the office comes to the patient's home.
This service particularly benefits Lake County's aging population. As people get older, hearing loss becomes more common, but so do the physical limitations that make routine appointments difficult. House calls ensure hearing care remains accessible regardless of mobility.
Technology That Reconnects People
Modern hearing aids differ dramatically from devices available even a decade ago. Today's technology reduces background noise, connects to smartphones and adjusts automatically to different environments. Clear Ear stays current with these advancements, helping patients benefit from improvements in hearing aid design.
For many people with hearing loss, the right device restores connections they'd lost. Phone conversations become clearer. Grandchildren's voices come through. Television doesn't need to blast at uncomfortable volumes. These changes seem small until someone experiences them.
Getting Started
Clear Ear Hearing Aid operates Monday through Saturday starting at 9 a.m. The practice recommends calling ahead for appointments, especially during holidays when hours may vary.
The free hearing evaluation provides a starting point for anyone concerned about hearing loss or interested in learning whether hearing aids might help. There's no obligation, just information from professionals who've worked in this field for three decades.
For current hearing aid users experiencing problems, the repair service handles issues across multiple brands. Regular patients can schedule their routine cleanings and check-ups to keep devices functioning properly.
Reach Clear Ear Hearing Aid at 219-934-9747 or visit clearearhearingaid.com for more information. The practice maintains an active Facebook page at facebook.com/clearearhearingaid with updates and resources for the Lake County community.

By offering free cleanings and check-ups every few months, the practice helps patients maintain optimal hearing aid function.
